description: Extracts impervious surfaces (buildings, roads, parking lots) from optical remote sensing imagery using NDBI or threshold methods. Computes impervious surface ratio and generates coverage maps to support sponge city planning and urban waterlogging risk assessment. Invoke when the user mentions "不透水面", "硬化地面", "海绵城市", "impervious", "NDBI", "建筑覆盖", "城市内涝" or similar triggers.
